Villa Solana

Set on a hillside above the harbor town of Port Ambrell, Villa Solana is a whitewashed villa with a private infinity pool and a shaded pergola. The villa has 4 bedrooms and 3 bathrooms, a fully equipped kitchen, and a large living room that opens onto the terrace.

Sleeps 8

Facilities
Private pool · Free WiFi · Air conditioning · Barbecue facilities · Free private parking · Dishwasher

Prices and fees
€320 per night (minimum 5 nights in July and August)
Refundable security deposit: €500, returned within 7 days
Final cleaning: €90

House rules
Check-in: from 16:00
Check-out: by 10:30
Smoking is not allowed indoors.
No parties or events.
Contact the owner: +1 (555) 555-0119
